title: ProntoPC Pod Contract
description: ProntoPC's own Pod DESIGN. The POD Architecture is general; a DataQuad-for-a-CyberPeer requires PEER/PCT/NCT/SPINE tensors, steward/advocate roles and a temporal daemon - a PC-repair product does not. ProntoPC's specific requirements are declared here: a thin orchestration core that owns nothing but phase sequencing, plus Orbs (inside) and Portals (outward), each attached by an Umbilical. Attach, don't affect: adding or removing a capability never edits the Pod core.

orchestrator.description: ProntoPC's equivalent of the Pod processor: the thin shell that sequences the phases (scan -> plan -> consent -> repair -> verify -> complete) by invoking attached Orbs across their Umbilicals. It owns orchestration state only - never diagnostic or repair logic.

portals.description: Orbs whose defining function crosses OUTWARD to a service the Pod does not own (Stripe, LLM providers, Cloud Run, the asset pipeline). Same attachment shape; outward-facing.

manifest_specs.description: The Manifest-of-Completion spec IDs whose PASS (with Auditor evidence) promotes this attachment to verified. This is the trust gate: an Orb is verified only when its specs pass.
